name: yantraflow
description: Free n8n-style automation platform: 50+ nodes in Trigger / Core / Flow / AI / Social / Data / Media categories, Error Center (what failed, where, why, how to fix), Terminal (PC shell + website console), AI Agent with tools, AI Project Generator, Photo + Video Maker, Auto Video Maker (Shorts/Reels), Daily Funny Video to YouTube + Instagram + Telegram, admin panel, schedules and a drag-and-drop editor. Runs in the browser or 24x7 on your PC / Android (Termux).
